verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own docs say users can 'configure vesting schedules for founders and employees' on its cap table, so the core capability is first-party. But that single thin mention gives no detail on the story's specific elements, and the community comment about real-time updates concerns equity transactions generally, not vesting. Missing for 10: documented cliff support, milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration on exit (single/double trigger), automatic tracking of vested vs unvested balances, and independent or hands-on corroboration of vesting features.
